outcome: Apgar score <7 at 5 min after birth
cohort: 371 women with planned vaginal breech (n=127) and twin (n=244) deliveries
finding: There were no statistically significant nor clinically relevant differences between the EA and remifentanil-PCA groups in any of the outcomes studied.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant differences in labor outcomes, including Cesarean section rates, between epidural analgesia and remifentanil patient-controlled analgesia in singleton breech and twin deliveries.
